# Conclusion {.unnumbered}

Here's a conclusion. In Quarto, an unnumbered chapter is just a chapter with
`{.unnumbered}` after its title; Quarto adds it to the table of contents and the running
headers for you.

So there is no manual counter-resetting or `\addcontentsline` bookkeeping as in the
plain LaTeX template. The chapter counter simply skips unnumbered chapters, so the
appendices that follow are lettered on their own.

## More info

And here's some other random info: the first paragraph after a chapter title or section
head *shouldn't be* indented, because indents tell the reader that a new paragraph is
starting, and that's obvious after a heading. LaTeX handles this for you in the PDF.
